{"predictors": [
{"name": "Research Intensity", "construction": "Research and development expense scaled by total assets, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms that invest more in research and development are more likely to experience future growth and innovation, leading to higher returns. This investment is a signal of a firm's commitment to long-term success.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration", "construction": "Herfindahl index of customer sales, calculated as the sum of the squares of the percentage of total sales attributed to each customer, averaged over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with a diverse customer base are less vulnerable to losses from any one customer, reducing their risk and potentially increasing returns. A lower customer concentration indicates a more stable revenue stream.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in total employees, averaged over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms that are expanding their workforce are likely experiencing growth and increasing demand for their products or services, leading to higher returns. A high employee growth rate signals a firm's ability to scale and adapt to changing market conditions.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability", "construction": "Environmental liability reserves scaled by total assets, averaged over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with significant environmental liabilities may face future costs and reputational damage, decreasing their returns. A lower environmental liability indicates a firm's commitment to sustainability and reduced risk.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Efficiency", "construction": "Days inventory outstanding plus days sales outstanding minus days payable outstanding, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with efficient supply chains can reduce costs and improve profitability, leading to higher returns. A lower supply chain efficiency measure indicates a firm's ability to manage its working capital effectively.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Diversification", "construction": "Herfindahl index of product sales, calculated as the sum of the squares of the percentage of total sales attributed to each product, averaged over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with a diverse product portfolio are less vulnerable to losses from any one product, reducing their risk and potentially increasing returns. A lower product diversification index indicates a more stable revenue stream.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Expansion", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in the number of countries with operations, averaged over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms that are expanding into new geographic markets are likely experiencing growth and increasing demand for their products or services, leading to higher returns. A high geographic expansion rate signals a firm's ability to adapt to changing market conditions.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Executive Stock Ownership", "construction": "Percentage of shares outstanding owned by executives, averaged over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with high executive stock ownership have more aligned incentives between executives and shareholders, leading to higher returns. A high executive stock ownership indicates a firm's commitment to long-term value creation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Innovation Rate", "construction": "Number of patents filed per year scaled by total assets, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms that innovate more are likely to experience future growth and increasing demand for their products or services, leading to higher returns. A high innovation rate signals a firm's commitment to research and development.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Board Independence", "construction": "Percentage of independent board members, averaged over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with independent boards are more likely to have effective governance and monitoring, reducing the risk of agency problems and potentially increasing returns. A high board independence indicates a firm's commitment to good governance.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
